tests.title: Editor cannot see another user's contacts or report
tests.goal: Contacts and reports of a template are visible only to its owner.
preconditions: The admin creates a QA editor (and, for viewer cases, a QA viewer) in 用戶管理 > 添加用户 and deletes them afterwards

steps.text: As admin create a draft template qa_owner_<unique> (Meta unticked) and upload the contacts file to it
Log out and log in as the QA editor
On 消息模版 click 從 Twilio 同步
In the address bar add /contacts to the template URL and open it
In the address bar open the report link: replace /templates/ with /api/templates/ and add /export to the template URL
Log back in as admin and delete qa_owner_<unique> (cleanup)

expected.text: After sync the editor's list does not show qa_owner_<unique>
The template page says 模板不存在
The contacts page shows no contacts (or a no-permission message), not QA Tester's name and phone
The report link does not download a file

notes: UI only: after sync the admin card shows, /contacts lists QA Tester, report link downloads reply_report_<id>.xlsx.

tests.title: Viewer cannot create templates or upload contacts
tests.goal: The 查看者 role is read-only.
preconditions: The admin creates a QA editor (and, for viewer cases, a QA viewer) in 用戶管理 > 添加用户 and deletes them afterwards

steps.text: Log in as the QA viewer
On 消息模版 click 從 Twilio 同步
Click 新建模板, untick Meta, enter qa_viewer_<unique>, body "QA viewer draft", button OK, click 創建模板
If created, open it and upload the contacts file

expected.text: 新建模板 and 從 Twilio 同步 are not offered to a viewer (or refused with a no-permission message)
No template is created and no contacts are uploaded
The viewer's list shows no other users' templates

notes: UI only: viewer sync shows admin templates, created qa_viewer_made (模板已創建！), uploaded a contact (上傳成功！).

tests.title: Editor cannot change contacts of another user's template
tests.goal: Contacts can only be reset or deleted by the template owner.
preconditions: The admin creates a QA editor (and, for viewer cases, a QA viewer) in 用戶管理 > 添加用户 and deletes them afterwards

steps.text: As admin create a draft template qa_owner_<unique> and upload the contacts file
Log in as the QA editor, click 從 Twilio 同步 and open the qa_owner_<unique> card
Add /contacts to the URL and open it
Click 全部重置 and confirm
Click the trash icon of QA Tester and confirm
Log in as admin, open the template's 聯繫人 (then delete the template as cleanup)

expected.text: The editor cannot reach the contacts page, or 全部重置 and delete are refused with a no-permission message
As admin, QA Tester is still there with its original status

notes: UI only: 全部重置 -> 重置成功！, trash -> contact deleted (0 contacts).
